name: Varbase Dashboards
description: Administrative dashboards built on the Dashboard module using Drupal core's Layout Builder, shipping enhanced blocks and views (content overview, drafts, recent changes, users, terms) and a default dashboard, primarily for the Varbase distribution.
project_description:
A dashboard is what's missing for better Drupal administration experience.

Varbase Dashboards is built on top of the Dashboard (drupal/dashboard) module and uses Drupal core's Layout Builder for dynamic dashboard management. It ships several enhanced blocks and widgets (a user welcome block, a content/comment overview block, and an "Add content" menu plugin) plus a set of Views (all content, drafts, recent changes, recently created, terms, users, scheduled publishing) that populate a default "Dashboard" layout for an intuitive and flexible administration experience.

The idea is to give site admins an appealing, concise dashboard that becomes the home of any Drupal site's administration task. An install recipe provisions the default dashboard, the supporting Views, and grants a graded set of dashboard permissions to the standard Varbase editorial roles. It is best used with the Varbase distribution but can be installed on any Drupal 11 site.
